name: OWASP API Security Top 10 Reference + Pytest Attack Suite
note: Each task runs a real command. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost directly. The reference API keeps documents and users in in-memory dicts and the rate limiter in a process-local store, so no database or Redis is needed. SSRF tests use IP literals, so no DNS or network access happens.

eval_tasks.title: API boots and serves the liveness probe
eval_tasks.instruction: The FastAPI app imports and answers GET /healthz without credentials.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_owasp_top10.py -k healthz -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Happy-path OWASP controls hold
eval_tasks.instruction: BOLA, auth, property filtering, rate limit, BFLA and SSRF behave correctly for the reference scenarios.
assertions: a stranger gets 403 on another owner's document
internal_secret is absent from user profiles
the 6th request in a window returns 429
a non-admin gets 403 on the admin route
metadata and loopback webhook targets return 403
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_owasp_top10.py -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Controls resist attack
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the adversarial suite: forged, none-alg, wrong-alg and expired JWTs; every private address form; over-limit pagination and payloads (declared and chunked); strict request schemas; rootless container.
assertions: alg=none, HS512, wrong-key, expired and sub-less tokens return 401
bodies over the cap return 413 with and without Content-Length
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_security.py -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Full suite and CLI runner green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete suite passes, including through the kit's own run_security_tests.py wrapper.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:warnings && python run_security_tests.py
